crop_box_convention: [left, top, right, bottom], right and bottom exclusive, source image pixels
method: Pillow Image.crop; PNG output pixels verified equal to the corresponding original pixels.
scope: Native game-panel state evidence only: active expedition, paused expedition, and paused state restored in a new process. Actor presence/absence, actual settlement and archive integrity require the separate native reports and actor captures; no natural-growth or long-soak claim.

images.description: Lossless crop of a native Windows desktop screenshot, limited to the game window including its blue border; no redraw, resize, compositing, masking or recoloring.

visual_review.result: Panel text and fixed bottom actions remain legible and intact; no other application pixels remain inside the crop.
